notes: Fixed: the ledger check now reads sub-headings that were recoloured in Excel (for example grey instead of blue), so items no longer show as being under a different sub-heading. “Keep the app’s sub-heading” no longer adds rows to the ledger when it can’t read a sub-heading, and says plainly if an item couldn’t be moved. New in the ledger check: repeated sub-headings with nothing under them can be tidied back to blank spare rows (a copy of the ledger is saved first).
